questions.question: Which state in India introduced the country's first dedicated policy for ships?
questions.questionHtml: Which state in India introduced the country's first dedicated policy for ships?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Maharashtra.

In News

  • Maharashtra has introduced India's first independent Shipbuilding, Ship Repair, and Ship Recycling Policy.

Key Points

  • The policy targets an investment of Rs 6,600 crore by 2030 to make Maharashtra a hub for shipbuilding, repair, and recycling.
  • It aims to create 40,000 jobs in the sector by 2030 through various incentives, including capital subsidies, skill development funds, and long-term land leases.
  • The initiative seeks to boost Maharashtra's maritime sector and contribute to India's growing shipbuilding industry.

Additional Information

  • Maharashtra's Shipbuilding Policy
    • The policy aims to streamline shipbuilding activities and increase Maharashtra's role in the global maritime industry.
    • It focuses on enhancing the state's infrastructure and providing incentives to businesses to set up shipbuilding and repair facilities.
  • Shipbuilding Industry in India
    • The shipbuilding industry plays a key role in India’s maritime trade and has the potential to provide significant economic benefits and employment opportunities.

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECT statement from the options below regarding the World Press Freedom Index 2025 :
questions.questionHtml: Identify the INCORRECT statement from the options below regarding the World Press Freedom Index 2025:

options.text: India ranked 151st out of 180 countries, improving its position by 8 places from 159th in 2024.
options.html: India ranked 151st out of 180 countries, improving its position by 8 places from 159th in 2024.

options.text: Norway topped the index with the highest press freedom score.
options.html: Norway topped the index with the highest press freedom score.

options.text: India ranks higher than Nepal, Maldives, and Sri Lanka in the 2025 index.
options.html: India ranks higher than Nepal, Maldives, and Sri Lanka in the 2025 index.

options.text: The 2025 report highlights a global decline in press freedom with over half the world’s population living under severe restrictions.
options.html: The 2025 report highlights a global decline in press freedom with over half the world’s population living under severe restrictions.

questions.solution:
The incorrect statement is in Option 3, which is India ranks higher than Nepal, Maldives, and Sri Lanka in the 2025 index.​

  • Option 1 is correct: India improved its rank to 151st in 2025 from 159th in 2024.
  • Option 2 is correct: Norway topped the World Press Freedom Index in 2025.
  • Option 3 is incorrect: India ranks lower than Nepal (90th), Maldives (104th), and Sri Lanka (139th).
  • Option 4 is correct: The report highlights worsening global press freedom, with significant restrictions affecting over half the world’s population.

In News

  • India’s position improved slightly in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index but remains in the “very serious” category for press freedom challenges.

Key Points

  • ​India ranks 151st out of 180 countries in the 2025 World Press Freedom Index, released by Reporters Without Borders (RSF), improving by 8 places from 159th in 2024.
  • Score: India scored 32.96 in the 2025 report.
  • Trend: India’s ranking has declined significantly over the past two decades, from 80th in 2002 to 151st, with a notable drop from 140th in 2019.
  • Challenges: Despite the improvement, India remains in the "very serious" category for press freedom, facing issues like media monopolization, political and economic pressures on journalists, misuse of sedition laws, and censorship on digital platforms.
  • Regional Comparison: India ranks lower than several neighbors like Nepal (90th), Maldives (104th), Sri Lanka (139th), and Bangladesh (149th), but ahead of Pakistan (158th), Myanmar (169th), Afghanistan (175th), and China (178th).
  • Global Context: Norway tops the index with a score of 92.31, while countries with the worst press freedom include Eritrea (180th), North Korea (179th), China (178th), Syria (177th), and Iran (176th).
  • Global Concerns: The RSF 2025 report highlights the "difficult" global press freedom situation for the first time in history, emphasizing threats like economic fragility and politically connected funding undermining editorial independence. Over half the world’s population lives in countries with severely restricted press freedom.

questions.question: Consider the following: Statement-I: Genome-edited rice varieties developed by India are classified as genetically modified (GM) crops. Statement-II: India is the first country in the world to develop rice using genome editing technology. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following:

Statement-I: Genome-edited rice varieties developed by India are classified as genetically modified (GM) crops.

Statement-II: India is the first country in the world to develop rice using genome editing technology.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.

In News

  • Indian scientists have made global history by producing two new climate-smart rice varieties using a 21st Century breeding technology called "genome editing". With this, India became the first country in the world to develop Genome-Edited or GE rice varieties.

Key Points

  • Statement I is incorrect:
    • The genome-edited rice varieties developed by India are not classified as genetically modified (GM) crops under the Indian regulatory framework.
    • The Department of Biotechnology (DBT) clarified that SDN-1 and SDN-2 category genome editing techniques (which do not involve insertion of foreign DNA), therefore will not be regulated as GMOs.
    • India distinguishes genome-edited crops from traditional transgenic GM crops.
  • Statement II is correct:
    • Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan recently announced that India has become the first country in the world to develop rice varieties using genome editing technology. Hence, Statement II is correct.

questions.question: What is the theme for the 2025 International Day of Families (IDF)?
questions.questionHtml: What is the theme for the 2025 International Day of Families (IDF)?

options.text: Family-Oriented Policies for Sustainable Development: Towards the Second World Summit for Social Development
options.html: Family-Oriented Policies for Sustainable Development: Towards the Second World Summit for Social Development

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​Family-Oriented Policies for Sustainable Development: Towards the Second World Summit for Social Development.

In News

  • International Day of Families: 15 May.

Key Points

  • Established in 1993: The UN General Assembly declared 15 May as the International Day of Families (IDF) through Resolution A/RES/47/237.

  • Purpose of IDF: Raises awareness about family-related issues and enhances understanding of social, economic, and demographic factors affecting families.

  • 2025 Theme: "Family-Oriented Policies for Sustainable Development: Towards the Second World Summit for Social Development".

  • Upcoming Summit: The Second World Summit for Social Development will be held in Doha, Qatar (4–6 November 2025).

  • Focus Areas of the Summit:

    • Poverty eradication

    • Decent work

    • Social inclusion

  • Foundation in 1995: Builds on the Copenhagen Declaration which emphasized:

    • Families as the foundation of society

    • Importance of work-family balance

    • Need for equal partnerships within households

questions.questionHtml: Which state government has extended the ₹1 lakh marriage incentive to couples where both spouses are differently-abled?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is Telangana.

In News

questions.question: Which state government launched the Mahila Samvad campaign aiming to reach 2 crore women for women empowerment?
questions.questionHtml: Which state government launched the Mahila Samvad campaign aiming to reach 2 crore women for women empowerment?
